groups.name: admin

commands.name: phase status
commands.description: Show progress of a phase scope

commands.name: phase delete
commands.description: Delete a saved phase scope

commands.name: phase list
commands.description: List all saved phase scopes

groups.name: retrieval
groups.description: Vector retrieval — token-efficient context via local embeddings

commands.name: retrieval stats
commands.description: Show token-savings transparency (how many tokens retrieval saved)

commands.name: retrieval index
commands.description: Index a repo/file into the retrieval store (chunks embedded locally)

commands.name: retrieval query
commands.description: Semantic search over the indexed repo (top-k chunks)

commands.name: retrieval clear
commands.description: Clear the retrieval index and token-savings stats

groups.name: knowledge
groups.description: Knowledge base — answer questions from your own tagged documents (vector retrieval)

commands.name: knowledge add
commands.description: Ingest files or folders under a tag (extracted, chunked and embedded once)

commands.name: knowledge query
commands.description: Retrieve the most relevant passages for a question, scoped to a tag

commands.name: knowledge toc
commands.description: List a tag's documents and the headings in each

commands.name: knowledge read
commands.description: Print a document, or one named section, VERBATIM (not a summary)

commands.name: knowledge remove
commands.description: Remove ONE document from a tag (its chunks, stored text and manifest row)

commands.name: knowledge sync
commands.description: Bring a tag up to date with its folders — hash-gated, prunes files that vanished

commands.name: knowledge list
commands.description: List knowledge tags with document and chunk counts

commands.name: knowledge stats
commands.description: Show details for one knowledge tag

commands.name: knowledge forget
commands.description: Remove a tag's vectors and manifest entry

groups.name: hooks
groups.description: Declarative lifecycle hooks — list/add/remove the rules that deny, notify or secret-scan tool calls (the same hooks.json the dashboard Hooks page edits; a hook is data, never code)

commands.name: hooks list
commands.description: List built-in and user hooks with their seam, action and state

commands.name: hooks add
commands.description: Declare a new hook (it is enabled unless --disabled is given)

commands.name: hooks remove
commands.description: Remove a user hook (a built-in cannot be deleted — disable it instead)

commands.name: hooks enable
commands.description: Turn a hook on (works on a built-in too)

commands.name: hooks disable
commands.description: Turn a hook off

groups.name: trace
groups.description: Inspect and replay per-step reasoning traces (every LLM call in a pipeline)

commands.name: trace list
commands.description: Show recent traces

commands.name: trace show
commands.description: Show a single trace (goal, timing, step summary)

commands.name: trace replay
commands.description: Step-by-step replay of a trace — every LLM call with prompt digest, model, tokens, latency, and routing

commands.name: trace degraded
commands.description: List provider × model pairs that served steps without agentic capability (derived, read-only, from the traces)

commands.name: trace clear
commands.description: Delete all stored traces

groups.name: rate
groups.description: Rate the last turn (good|bad) — records the one label a quality signal can be fit to (also on the dashboard Trace tab)

groups.name: decisions
groups.description: The must-ask decisions recorded for this project — list, search, and revise them (written by ask_user)

groups.name: continuity
groups.description: Session continuity — what is stored, and how to forget it

commands.name: continuity list
commands.description: Show the continuity switches, stored sessions, and the semantic recall index

commands.name: continuity clear
commands.description: Forget stored continuity data (no flags = both sessions and recall)

groups.name: website
groups.description: Open the Agent-Nuvira website — capabilities, commands, docs, setup
